description: Self-register this agent and get an Agent Flights API key instantly (free; no email confirmation). Use it as Authorization: Bearer <apiKey> (or x-api-key) on /mcp and /api/v1 for higher limits and booking-click attribution. Optional: guests can use every tool without a key. Example: {"name":"Trip planner","client":"claude"}. The key is shown once.

client.description: Host client, e.g. claude, chatgpt, cursor, codex. Used for attribution.

contact.description: Optional developer email for key notices. Never shared.

name.description: Your agent or app name, e.g. "Trip planner GPT".

website.description: Optional homepage of the agent or app.

name: register_agent

apiKey.description: Shown once. Send as Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>.
